rationale: With only 20 minutes to close, the stock is sitting at 92% of its intraday range after a 9% gap-up on strong earnings, showing a mild drift lower over the last 5 candles (from 22.07 down to 21.95) with declining momentum. The risk/reward is unfavorable: going long near the day's high with 20 minutes left and a forced market-close liquidation exposes to end-of-day profit-taking on a gap-up name, while going short against a strong earnings catalyst and a broad market up 1.77% carries equal risk. The account is already down on the day, and the mechanical setup does not offer a clean asymmetric entry in either direction.
